body.name: two-cell split-support Rademacher family
body.construction: For each \(n\), set \(K=2\), \(\mathcal X=\{x_1,x_2\}\), \(n_1=n_2=n\), \(p_T(x_1)=p_T(x_2)=1/2\), \(\mathcal H_1=\{x_1\}\), \(\mathcal H_2=\{x_2\}\), \(p_j(x_j)=1\), and \(e_j(x_j)=1/2\). In source \(j\), draw independent \(C\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(\mu_n)\) and Rademacher \(\varepsilon\); set \(D_j(0)=0\), \(D_j(1)=C\), and \(Y_j(z,d)=1/2+\varepsilon/(2\sqrt2)\) for all \(z,d\). Give the target the equally weighted mixture of the cell laws and denote the law by \(P_n^{\mathrm{split}}\).
